subject: Follow-up: deployment mode & preliminary TCO for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@nimbushealth.com>, Jake Porter <jporter@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-02-10T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: deployment mode & preliminary TCO for Nimbus Health

Hi Samira / Jake —

Thanks again for the call today. Short recap and asks so we can get you a clean, comparable set of pricing scenarios across Hosted (per-token), Dedicated (reserved capacity), and Private (VPC/on-prem).

Recap of what I heard from the discovery:
- Primary use case: clinical note generation + summarization for physician workflows (PHI).
- Expected steady-state usage: ~25M tokens / month (combined prompts + completions).
- Typical prompt + completion length: ~350 tokens average.
- Traffic profile: steady daytime load (~40 reqs/sec), with peaks up to ~140 reqs/sec during rounding windows.
- Latency target: p95 < 250ms for short (single-turn) requests; embeddings can tolerate higher latency.
- Compliance: HIPAA + SOC 2 required; data residency must be within US.
- Procurement timeline: aiming for contract signature in Q2 if numbers line up.

Immediate asks for the model/pricing scoping:
1) Confirm the 25M tokens/month estimate (or provide updated monthly volume).
2) Clarify whether you need a BAA (we support HIPAA/BAAs on Dedicated and Private; Hosted can also be covered — we’ll note how that affects ops).
3) Any hard constraints on peak p99 latency or burst concurrency beyond the numbers above?

Next steps — I will produce a short spreadsheet with three TCO scenarios (Hosted per-token, 12m Reserved Dedicated, and Private VPC on customer infra) and send it back by EOD tomorrow. That will include 1) estimated monthly cost, 2) expected latency profile, 3) operational tradeoffs and lead times.

If you’re available, I’d like to book a 30-min follow-up next Tue to walk the spreadsheet and recommend a canary approach.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference | M: +1 415-555-0192

From: Samira Khan <skhan@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jake Porter <jporter@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2027-02-10T18:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: deployment mode & preliminary TCO for Nimbus Health

Thanks Marcus — good summary. A few clarifications before you build scenarios:

1) Volume: updated estimate is closer to 30M tokens/month for Q3 baseline (we expect growth). Please model both 30M and 60M (growth scenario).
2) HIPAA/BAA: yes, we will require a signed BAA and evidence of SOC 2 Type II. Can you flag which deployment modes include BAA support out of the box and any timing/approval caveats?
3) Data residency & KMS: For the Private/VPC option we will need customer-managed keys (KMS) and the ability to restrict egress to our VPC. If you can include whether Hosted supports bring-your-own-key and what the additional cost/latency implications are, that would be helpful.
4) Latency: p95 < 300ms would be acceptable for the clinical flows; p99 target is softer. Peak concurrency: burst to ~200 reqs/sec for short periods is possible.
5) Procurement: procurement will want a line-itemed operating vs. capital view — please include both monthly OPEX numbers and any one-time setup fees in the spreadsheet.

We can do the follow-up next Tue 2/16 10:00am PT — tentative on our side, will confirm.

—Samira Khan
Head of Product Integrations | Nimbus Health
skhan@nimbushealth.com | +1 650-555-8877

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@nimbushealth.com>, Jake Porter <jporter@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2027-02-11T08:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: deployment mode & preliminary TCO for Nimbus Health

Samira — thanks for the clarifications. Attached is a first-pass spreadsheet (Nimbus_TCO_v1.xlsx) that models the two volumes you asked for (30M / 60M tokens). High-level summary below — will walk through in the 2/16 sync if that works.

Quick conclusions (30M tokens / month baseline):
- Hosted API (Redwood hosted, per-token): ~ $24,000 / month at current rate assumptions (approx $0.0008 per token effective) — pros: fastest time-to-value, no infra ops, built-in SOC2 and optional BAA. Cons: higher marginal cost at scale and less control over private networking (we can support BYOK for hosted but with additional key management steps).

- Dedicated (reserved capacity, 12-month commit): ~ $13,500 / month (committed monthly spend) assuming a 4-GPU dedicated pool sized for your peak profile; includes SLA and dedicated capacity isolation. Pros: much lower unit cost at scale, predictable latency, Redwood handles runtime and upgrades. Cons: 1) commit required, 2) provisioning lead time (~2–4 weeks), 3) less flexible if you undershoot commit (we can discuss burst options).

- Private VPC / On-prem: one-time deployment/setup ~ $48,000 (engineering + deployment) + $8,000 / month support & control plane fee; infra (if you supply) is not included. Pros: full control, easiest to meet strict KMS/egress/VPC requirements and PHI controls. Cons: highest up-front and operational burden; longer lead time for air-gapped/on-prem installs.

Notes and assumptions included in the spreadsheet:
- Token pricing assumptions, average prompt/completion tokens, model family used (we used an Llama-derivative baseline for parity), and expected GPU sizing.
- Hosted BYOK: supported but requires additional compliance sign-off and a small latency impact (we've quantified ~5–15ms in the notes).
- BAA/SOC2: Hosted and Dedicated both supported; Private is customer-managed but we provide documentation and an attestation package.

Attachments: [Attachment: Nimbus_TCO_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 68KB)], [Attachment: Redwood_Private_VPC_FAQs.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

Next steps proposed:
1) I’ll schedule a 30-min walk-through for Tue 2/16 at 10:00am PT (tentative) — confirm if that works.
2) Camila / Solutions: can you validate the Dedicated GPU sizing assumptions in tab 'Sizing' and propose a small canary configuration (1–2 GPUs) that we could start with?
3) Samira — if procurement wants a formal quote, we can convert the preferred scenario into a line-item proposal with term options.

If you want anything moved up faster (e.g., an NDA or BAA in advance), tell me and I’ll prioritize.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0192

Camila / Lauren — looping you in to action items from the Nimbus Health discovery. Highlights and asks:
- They want a formal comparison across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Spreadsheet attached covers baseline assumptions (30M / 60M tokens).
- Please validate Dedicated sizing: I used a conservative 4xA10-style GPU pool to meet their peak burst to ~200 rps and p95 < 300ms. Confirm if a 3x config + autoscale burst would work and what the performance delta looks like.
- Camila, can you draft a canary plan (1–2 GPU pilot) that reduces initial commit risk? Include expected latency, ramp cadence, and rollback criteria.
- Lauren, can you prepare a procurement-ready line-item quote for the Dedicated 12-month commit option (numbers in the spreadsheet) and include OPEX vs CapEx treatment notes? Procurement will want those line items to present to their finance team.

I’ve set a tentative 2/16 10:00am PT walk-through with Samira — please confirm availability and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — Marcus
